monument_name: Subāhāḥ Hiti Phalcā (c. late 18th cent. CE)
description_en: Subāhāḥ Hiti Phalcā has an unusual L-shaped plan and is located to the north-west of Subāhāḥ Hiti. Thephalcāhas six bays anda dwarf storey. Its proximity to a water source (hiṭī) that dates back to the Licchavi period makes it a particularly interesting place. Thephalcāis connected to a house and has been rebuilt several times, most recently in 1993. This reconstruction saw the columns extended in height by 43 cm and the addition of windows to the dwarf storey above. One of the struts on the south-eastern corner displays carvings, however the rest are plain. Inside thephalcā, one can find a Hāratī Ajimā statue dated to the 3rd century, as well as a Gaṇeśa statue (Gaṇeśa being the lineage deity for the Śākyas of Subāhāḥ) and an inscription dated 1025 NS (1905 CE).
description_ne: सुबाहा हितिबाट उत्तरपश्चिमपट्टि अवस्थित छवटा क्वल भएको एल् आकारको, अनि एउटा होचो तला भएको यो फल्चा दक्षिणपूर्वतर्फ फर्केको छ । सुबाहा हिति लिच्छविकालीन धारा हो । यो फल्चाको केही भाग पछाडिको घरसँग जोडिएको छ । यो फल्चा धेरै पटक भत्कियो र धेरै पटक यसको पुनर्निर्माण पनि भयो । यसको अन्तिम पटकको पुनर्निर्माण सन् १९९३ मा भएको थियो । त्यस क्रममा यसका काष्ठस्तम्भहरूलाई ४३ सेमि अग्ल्याइएको थियो र होचो तलामा झ्यालहरू थपिएको थियो । फल्चाको दक्षिणपूर्वी कुनाको एउटा टुँडाल कुँदिएको छ भने बाँकी सबै सादा छन् । फल्चामा तेस्रो शताब्दीको हारती अजिमाको मूर्ति, सुबाहाका शाक्यहरूको कुलदेवता गणेशको मूर्ति र नेसं १०२५ को एउटा शिलालेख छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The stone inscription on the Phalcā records that five elders (Lakṣmidhaṃ, Siṃgha, Kulamānasi, Lakṣmījoti and Bekhā) and other members of thesaṅghacompleted the renovation of the Phalcā on a Wednesday during the dark fortnight of Āśvina in NS 1025 (1905 CE).
Reconstruction of the Phalcā with the help of GTZ/udle.
GTZ/udle helped during the reconstruction of the Phalcā.
